changes_by_reviewer: This review writes only its nonaccepted artifact receipt; no four-path implementation edits, staging, commit, workflow launch, host install or workload.
checks: Workflow uses actual PR head/push SHA, pinned official actions, contents:read, pull_request rather than pull_request_target, persist-credentials:false and ephemeral hosted Ubuntu runner. No secret or publication/deployment step is present. PR code is untrusted but receives no elevated repository mutation permission.

Raw Git blob identity verification covers every tracked path before CPU compilation; final independently streamed size/SHA inventory rejects changes/additions/removals. No source-byte normalization is performed by the runner. Finite165 attributes and Linux initial checkout remain the source-byte contract; clean checkout must pass raw verification.

Missing build prerequisites, six explicit target build failures and actual unittest failures propagate nonzero. All three explicitly required Linux native regression IDs must be recorded successes; absence or skip is not accepted as a pass. Other hardware/data skips are fully listed.

AST parsing and Bash syntax checks are explicit limited checks, not invented type/linter/behavior conformance. OpenSpec strict/all/archived validation is separate structure validation. specification_inventory reports behavior_conformance as requiring a reviewed evidence map; it does not infer scenario implementation coverage.

Original command output files and test runner log, command returncodes/timeouts, before/after inventories and a successful:false report remain available on ordinary failures. always() artifact upload retains available logs; a job cancellation/90min timeout or early installation failure may leave no complete script report and must never be counted as successful CI.

Dependency pins are copied from the observed frozen host and installed only on the ephemeral CI runner. pip --no-deps plus pip check rejects unresolved dependency consistency; actual version availability and complete hosted execution remain unproven until an original run passes. System apt packages and hosted runner are not benchmark runtime/package authority.
residual_gates: No hosted workflow was launched or inspected by this review. The parent-reported five Windows report-helper tests are not the Ubuntu CPU build/discovery result.
Ninety-minute hosted capacity, available17 dependency versions and actual all-discovery behavior must be demonstrated on the final exact commit; do not pre-mark task16.1 complete.

A green CPU status cannot close final requirement/scenario conformance, GPU/model parity, native pairs, qualification/Q4/full scientific results, storage admission or archive/final approval. The mandatory final conformance evidence map and latest-commit checks remain separate open gates.
